design: Locally frozen separately authored source-vintage check; same AI research process, not independent researcher or blind holdout

selection.source_rule: Company-hosted NVIDIA full-year FY2026 results release, annual GAAP revenue and explicitly reported endpoints; choose first official matching release, no outcome-based switching

freeze_scope: Unchanged iteration15 calendar validator/config and legacy policies/scoring; task definitions and source selection locked before new-source search/download and execution. Calendar label issue already observed in code before freeze.
semantics: reported_adjacent_fiscal_year_growth; compare reported totals without duration normalization; preserve reported FY labels even when different from endpoint calendar year
availability: Constructed decision dates relative to selected release date; both records available_at selected release, not earliest historical availability
period_starts: Use explicit source-verified endpoints; base_start is inferred one day after FY2024 endpoint in already archived company source; current_start one day after FY2025 endpoint. Mark inference, do not invent week counts.
scoring: 12 decimal places rational integer oracle using annual million-USD values; correct answer, wrong accepted answer, safe abstention, unnecessary abstention; same financial_contract_pilot.score
failure_policy: No baseline changes, tuning, case exclusion or source substitution after observed outcomes. If retrieval fails retain failure and run observed-data semantic negative-control audit labeled developmental.
